definitions.fps: Distinct encoded Perspective frame IDs; not UI callbacks or RDP client video frames
definitions.steady: Trim first 1 s and final 250 ms from each 8 s navigation phase
definitions.active_gaps: All creation, Boolean request, worker and publication callback intervals; final idle/settling separate
definitions.fixture: Independent overlapping radius-5 sphere pairs, distance 5, grid 20 x 16 mm; BooleanUnion DeleteInput=Yes
definitions.source_checks: Native volume pairs*1125*pi/4, bounds, closed, pairs solids, zero naked edges; display counts and 4x final targets
definitions.native_timing: UI; platform+tessellation; painter-to-next-input including rendering/presentation/event-loop wait

test_command: cargo test -p om9-app --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 --test navigation_deadlines --test boolean_publication --test viewport_detail --test display_modes --test display_persistence
